0022600120.text: The Timberwolves (3-0, winners of three straight, 2-0 on the road) are 3rd in the Northwest and 6th in the West, while the Cavaliers (1-1, 1-0 at home) are 3rd in the Central, 1.5 games back, and 9th in the East. Minnesota is missing Donte DiVincenzo, who is out following Achilles surgery, and Anthony Edwards, who is day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 and have not met yet in 2026-27, and their last meeting was on January 10, 2026, in Cleveland, where the Timberwolves lost 146-134.
